description: This Java class implements a command strategy for retrieving policies based on the SudoRetrievePolicy command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically handling policy retrieval without valid authorization.

classes.name: SudoRetrievePolicyStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy that processes SudoRetrievePolicy commands to retrieve policies without valid authorization, producing a Result of PolicyEvent.

methods.name: SudoRetrievePolicyStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the SudoRetrievePolicy class.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command within a context, retrieving the policy entity and constructing a Result with the response.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next EntityTag for the policy, if available.
